anti_cherry_pick_result.rule: Every repository newly nameable relative to the prior public census receives an explicit disposition; lack of immediate candidate generation is itself recorded.

validation_ceiling: Current public list/count/digest and the exact historical prior-public cut are source-validated. Private/all-name digests remain externally supplied commitments and this public artifact does not claim content-wide proof that no private name occurs anywhere.
